purpose: Determine whether the attempt-7 path-enum mismatch was caused by the 256-token generation cap truncating the named tool-call output.
controlledDifferenceFromAttempt07: Only increase max_tokens for both named tool stages from 256 to 512. Keep model, TP=2 across both GPUs, KV pin, GPU_UTIL, DFlash2, fixture, path enums, named choices, thinking-off, temperature, top-p, top-k, min-p, seed, final-answer token cap and all other settings unchanged.
passCriteria: exactly one read_file call with pathMatchesContract=true
exactly one write_file call with pathMatchesContract=true and contentMatchesFixture=true
nonempty final answer and output bytes equal fixture
interpretationLimit: A pass tests only the named, enum-constrained tool loop at 512 token cap. It does not validate auto tool selection, LlamaCode integration, comparative speed/quality, or adoption.
failurePolicy: One run only, no automatic retry. If the contract still fails, classify the candidate tool loop as blocked and do not run Tool-Eval; analyze before any different runtime change.
